answer: Start from heartbeat variability profile proof. Every identity must clear it before its first answer counts. A farm running 454 aliases would need 454 separate proofs, each costing about 101 POA or 16 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. What carries the canyon here is verification, the ridge of cost is what stops the farm, and the shale of the record keeps every claim checkable. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
